split_roles.purpose: Future policy learning or training after rights, safety, and lineage checks.

split_roles.eligible_source_policy: Project-authored synthetic scenarios from a distinct predeclared scenario/persona/template pool.
split_roles.purpose: Development, prompt, configuration, and hyperparameter selection.

split_roles.eligible_source_policy: Reserved project-owned synthetic scenarios sampled from the same target design family but disjoint by subject/persona, episode template, and authored scenario seed.
Reserved subjects/personas absent from TRAIN, DEV, and other test roles.
Reserved task templates or task families absent from training examples.
Reserved timeline spacings, event orderings, or decision horizons not used in TRAIN or DEV.
Reserved, rights-qualified source family/version; external evidence content remains outside patient-memory namespace.
Reserve capability combinations while exposing individual capabilities in TRAIN; candidate held-out combinations include MEMORY+RAG, MEMORY+TEAM, RAG+TEAM, and ALL.
Public benchmark/evidence sources retaining their official identity, split, and provenance; only after source-specific rights and exposure checks.
split_roles.purpose: External transfer claim; never silently pooled into project-owned IID/OOD roles.

frozen_split_invariants: No source row, query, answer, qrel, image, clinical record, or benchmark gold is assigned by this policy document.
A subject/persona and all linked episodes belong to exactly one project split.
A scenario template and its paraphrases, transformations, or counterfactual siblings stay in one split.
Split assignment is performed before prompt tuning, failure-taxonomy changes, or hyperparameter selection against the assigned role.
Source family and immutable source version are part of lineage; content from different rights regimes is never collapsed into one source label.
Memory/patient state and external evidence remain separate namespaces and separate lineage parents.
Any public benchmark moved from EXTERNAL_TRANSFER to another role requires explicit permission and forfeits the external-transfer claim for those records.
A TEST role must be held by an independent evaluator; test access, row emission, or answer inspection is recorded in the exposure register.

ood_axis_definitions.OOD_PATIENT: new synthetic subject/persona identities, with no subject-level overlap across roles.
ood_axis_definitions.OOD_TASK: task intent, schema, or task family held out as a unit.
ood_axis_definitions.OOD_TEMPORAL: timeline cadence, chronology pattern, event order, or prediction horizon held out as a unit.
ood_axis_definitions.OOD_SOURCE: external evidence publisher/source/version family held out as a unit, after content rights are qualified.
ood_axis_definitions.OOD_COMPOSITION: capability compositions held out while individual capabilities may appear separately in TRAIN.
